title: the family-name guard asserts it actually scanned the surface (a guard that went quiet when its subject disappeared)
objective: Fix the anti-vacuity hole in the guard shipped by WP-2026-0109: it collected badf-* tokens by rglob over skills/badf-build/** and asserted none unresolved, so with the directory moved aside it passed in 0.000s -- absence of the surface indistinguishable from a clean surface, and the very defect it was written to catch would vanish under a rename. Adopt the idiom this repository already carries at tests/test_badf_schema_drift.py:31 -- a module-level non-emptiness assertion whose comment names this failure mode, fired at import so it cannot be forgotten by whoever adds the next test -- and keep in-test assertions for the partial cases a non-emptiness check cannot see: the router absent, the frozen reference set changed, or a scan that read files without finding the family naming itself.
business_value: A guard that reports OK when its subject is gone is worse than no guard: it is a green light nobody re-examines. This is the tenth instance of the class tonight and the second introduced while remediating, so the remedy is consistency with prior art rather than a new invention.
in_scope: tests/test_badf_build_contract.py: module-level SURFACE + non-emptiness assertion in the schema-drift idiom (cited); in-test presence, frozen-reference-set and self-naming assertions
badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0099.json; GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine note; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier; reconcile WP-2026-0109
out_of_scope: the six references carrying no CONTENT assertion -- a different defect, measured while here and filed as #230 / GOV-0100 rather than folded in
a repo-wide vacuity sweep or detector (BADF-REV's, and it must catch the derived-collection shape or it inherits this blind spot)
any gate, schema or other family's surface
acceptance_criteria: with skills/badf-build/ absent the module fails loudly under both runners (import AssertionError naming the mode; FAILED (errors=1) under discover) -- verified, not asserted
with references/ absent or the frozen set changed, the guard fails
intact surface green; probes restored byte-identical after every vector
the idiom cites tests/test_badf_schema_drift.py:31 rather than inventing a parallel one
evidence: before: surface absent -> Ran 1 test OK in 0.005s (vacuous)
after: surface absent -> AssertionError at import / FAILED (errors=1) under discover
intact -> 10 OK; every probe restored byte-identical

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
